notes.title: Development Blog: Electro Caves
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/a2ba729727b32c906aa41c13cce82f9a79b3dde9.png
Lorenzo Tatagila and his goons has built a base in the electro caves. I need YOU to bring Lorenzo down!
-Mr.B 

Greetings Voidlings! It has been a long time since our last announcement since our focus has been on developing new and old environments as well as the multiplayer feature. Here is a peek at the new map Electro Caves where Lorenzo Tatagilas goons have been busy building their hideout. This new dimension will bring with it the following content and more: 
New dimension with it's own unique theme and content
New enemies
New boss
New player items 
New music

Dimension
(new) Electro Caves 

Tatagila and his goons have been busy building their headquarters over at Electro Caves

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/1883a7aab6284a08f232316e48cf3ab790b1a486.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/4c6195471098ced7e2ca81761f51964159972441.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/8f3a5469fd15856da35663b06fb9c2902f1233b4.png
(new) Foes
Stonk rat

This tanky new foe can be found around the kitchen
"what has he been eating?"
A powerful and tanky rat that you have to shoot from afar or you will realise how hard he hits

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/98fe6922a1f16d3c7e3464a849298774e58c562a.png

Bodyguard rat

Another heavy unit equipped with military weaponry and an armoured vest
"I don't think he works for the military"
This new plated rat seems dangerous equipped with armour and heavy weapons that your gonna regret messing with

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/d70ce9f06379714e08e0ea44ca7720b0b3282af2.png

Wizardo rat

Don't let this skinny magicians looks fool you
"He just scammed me out of 50 bucks!"
This rat street performance artist carries only a magicians wand, looks innocent enough.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/d7e802904e903da5f0e2c185cc3a63f172af5783.png

Gunner rat

The most common foe found around Electro caves
Your typical rat goon, most of Tatagilas group concists of these gunners which are weak alone but their strength lies in numbers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/d875b5ce8a33e04aac9b1bfd4922578e0cc66b50.png

Items

be on the lookout for new items as well this update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/62c976947987a578d88d07f19de2beca47150000.png
Boss
new Lorenzo Tatagila

Kingpin of the rats
Lorenzo is the leader of the rat goons for a reason as you will find out..
Equipped with two light machine guns he will leave you looking like swiss cheese if you let your guard down during your visit through his domain

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/4a38b3d83bcb6d5d0d9a8efbcd7d5b5eeab718ee.png

Overall the next playtest update will be bringing along a lot of new content and variation, especially for all of the warriors who played Nightmare a bunch of times during the first playtest! Electro Caves exclusively features it's own unique foes and environment which gives the game a completely different vibe, so stay put for the next big update!

Before the big update that will be in the playtest 2.0 we will be updating you on all the major features we have been working on so far. We will also be holding polls and making your suggestions into reality over on our discord. So head on over if you want to choose what is added next!

notes.title: Patch Notes [March 7th 2024]
notes.content:
[Items]

 Carrot:

 Changed required amount of jumps to add a stack, from 10 to 100.


[Misc]

 Added 'Snuffles'.
 Item pickup popup UI added.
 Stats are now shown on the End screen.
 Updated icons for all items.
 Soul Drainer now has attack sound.
 Hover UI for chests now show the correct icon for Soul Coins.
 All SFX are in the correct audio groups.
 Gloves now highlight when hovered.
 Item models added for:

 Strong Phone
 Staff of Anubis
 Ticket Printer
 Unitronix Ticket
 Xray Glasses

notes.title: Patch Notes [February 17th 2024]
notes.content:
[Misc]

 Fixed bug where nothing worked anymore after changing dimension.
 Unitronix Fusionizer model update.

notes.title: Patch Notes [February 15th 2024]
notes.content:
[Items]

 Xp Fueled Generator:

 New visual effect on healing aura.

 Roboboy:

 Removed since it didn't do anything.

 Stick:

 Buffed, changed kills needed per stack from 50 to 10.

 Scimitar:

 New model.
 Doesn't search for a new target if it already has one.
 Added trail.

 Crow:

 Doesn't search for a new target if it already has one.

 Holy Cross:

 Added HUD element displaying cooldown.
 Shockwave effect added when it procs.

 Lightning Talisman:

 Doesn't attack dead enemies anymore.

 Secret Item added.

[Abilities]

 Bullet Ballet (Jack's Primary):

 Each consecutive shot is spaced 0.1 sec from each other.
 Cooldown for each charge is set to 0.5 sec.


[Misc]

 Zahir now spawns on the same level as the player, instead of preferring the lower level.
 Zipline: one can grab onto the line now as well.
 Removed a place where enemies could jump from one platform to another.
 New enemy wave spawn system.
 Added missing colliders to some environment objects.
 Pause screen can't be opened from end screen anymore.
 Spawn particle effect added to enemy gunners.
 Started implementation of game data collection, in a future update information of the previous run will be displayed on the end screen.

notes.title: Patch Notes [February 13th 2024]
notes.content:
Scimitar (item):

 Description matches the real values (said 10% when the actual value was 50%).
 Decreased attack interval from 5sec => 1sec.
 Decreased attack range from 10 units => 2 units.
 Increased enemy search range from 15 units => 20 units.
 Increased move speed from 10 => 20.
 Doesn't attack dead enemies anymore.
 Doesn't get removed on Dimension change.

 Crow (item):

 Damage dealt is now based on the owner's Damage stat (2x).
 Decreased attack interval 10 sec => 5 sec.
 Doesn't attack dead enemies anymore.
 Doesn't get removed on Dimension change.

 Xray Glasses (item):

 Chest Beams spawn again on Dimension change.

 Cursed Talisman of Greed (item):

 Removed, since it should do stuff that hasn't been implemented yet.

 Tornado Havoc (ability):

 Damage multiplier increased from 1 => 2.
 Description gives more information now.

 New item models added for :

 Unstable shield
 Rain cloud
 Piece of Bastion
 Mirror
 Broken Mirror
 Fortified Shield
 Double Edged Sword
 Cursed Idol
 Gravity Field
 Shocking Shield
 Stun Grenade

 New enemy spawn waves implemented (one doesn't get swarmed 2 minutes into the game anymore).
 When player is under 25% HP, the damage overlay is constantly visible.
 All enemies give different amount of soul coins when killed.
 Enemy health now scales correctly with their levels.

notes.title: Patch Notes [February 11th 2024]
notes.content:
Stick (item):

 Shows stack amount on a HUD element.
 Instead of giving a stack each kill, now requires 50 kills for each stack.

 Blue Pill (item) :

 Doesn't increase jump amount by 5% (which caused one to get double jump with only 1 blue pill in the inventory)

 Tip of The Pyramid (item):

 Added Hud element for stack amount.
 Functions like intended now.

 Staff of Anubis (item):

 Doesn't spam chat on proc anymore.

 Mr Gugda (item):

 Doesn't think its a Mystic item anymore.

 Deal Finder's Medallion (item):

 Removed from the playtest (did nothing in the current stage of the game).

 Bullet Ballet (Jack's primary ability):

 Doesn't empty mag anymore if button is held.

 On level up (both player and enemies) heal the difference of the new and old health amount.
 Difficulty scaling changes; made it harder in the later Dimensions.
 Zahir's level increases with the difficulty.
 Hovering over an item in the Unitronix and then leaving with the 'esc' key, now hides the tooltip.
 Completing an item set doesn't spam the chat anymore.
